remarks:
Set on 2 acres in Findley Lake, this beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2 full bath ranch-style home combines modern updates with cozy, comfortable living. Offering 1,776 square feet of thoughtfully designed space, nearly every inch of the home has been renovated, making it truly move-in ready.

The open-concept kitchen and living area creates a warm and inviting atmosphere, perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen features butcher block countertops with a large center island that can fit seating for up to six, all new appliances installed in 2021 or 2026, and a spacious walk-in pantry with shelving. A formal dining room with oversized windows fills the space with natural light and offers beautiful views.

The fully renovated primary suite, completed last year, features a walk-in closet with exceptional storage, quartz double sink vanity countertops, and luxurious heated bathroom floors.

Additional highlights include a large entryway, convenient porch access from the laundry room, a heated 2-car garage, and a fully fenced backyard with low-maintenance vinyl fencing. Step outside to enjoy the expansive back deck along with a bonus bar room/storage shed — ideal for entertaining, hobbies, or extra storage.

This charming one-story property offers the perfect combination of modern convenience and peaceful country living.
